main_text.p: שְׁרִיבְתָא, שְׁרִיבָא Ch. Siccum, aridum, Prov. 17.1.
Syr. Generatio: tribus, familia, Emph. ܐܚܕܐ ... Pl. Generationes, Tribus. Duodecim tribus, Jac. 1.1. Act. 26.7.
* שְׁרִבֵּב Ch. Demittere per funem, Jerem. 38.6.11. Vide supra in שבב. Ithpahel אִשְׁתְּרִבֵּב Vide paulo ante.

שְׁרְבִיטָא, שְׁרְבִיט Chal. Virga, baculus, scipio, flagellum, scutica, Exod. 21.20. in T. Jon. Plur. שְׁרְבִיטִין Flagella, scuticæ: Item Propagines, surculi, palmites, Genes. 40.12. in Targ. Hierof. quę significatio orta videtur ex præcedenti voce Syr. שְׁרָבָא.
שׁוּרְבָּן Ch. Cedri procerae species. Forte Sorbus, quæ vox Affinis. Plur. שׁוּרְבָּנֵי, Cantic. 1.17. & 3.9. In Regiis Transfertur Pinus.
שְׁרָנָא & cum prothesi אַשְׁרָנָא Chald. & Syr. Lucerna, Lumen. Perficè dicitur צְרָנָא, ש commutato in ץ.
שְׁרַנ Ch. Saliit, subsiliit, Infinit. לְמִשְׁרַנ נְהוֹן Ad saliendum cum eis, Levit. 11.21. in Jon.
שְׁרַנַּנ Ch. Persuadere, seducere, pellicere. Quadratum ex רְנָּא. Ithpahel אִשְׁתְּרַנַּנ Seductus fuit.
שְׁרַנּוֹגָא & שְׁרַנִּגֵי, שְׁרַנִּגִּין Ch. Simplices, fatui, qui facile seducuntur, Psal. 119.130. Psal. 116.6.
שְׁרַח Ethpah. Syr. Exarsit libidine, prurivit, ad Rom. 1.27. 1.Pet. 4.4.
שְׁרִיחָא Ch. Mœrens, Tristis, Hinc, כְּיוֹנָה שְׁרִיחָתָא Tanquam columba Tristis, mœrore se conficiens, Hos. 7.11. scil. ob ablatos pullos, ut Hebræi explicant.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldean words are transcribed approximately; several vowel-pointed forms and Syriac script lines are uncertain and may contain errors. Scripture references are copied as printed.
